PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS Forward Looking

PHOTOS: A group of young women (TechGirls participants) listening to a woman speaking inside a facility next to a Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope display.
Caption:
TechGirls Tour NASA Goddard
NASA Goddard hosted participants from the U.S. Department of State’s TechGirls program once again this summer. On Aug. 1, 2024, 133 girls from 37 different countries/territories toured Goddard’s research labs and TV production studios and heard from a panel of some of the incredible women that work at Goddard.
PHOTO CREDIT: NASA/Jay Friedlander

KEY FACTS:
- 133 girls participated in the TechGirls program.
- Participants came from 37 different countries/territories.
- The tour took place on Aug. 1, 2024.
- Program hosted by NASA Goddard.
- Program is from the U.S. Department of State’s TechGirls program.
